description: Explore. This is the single-factor version of E011, separating its two confounded changes. On the E016 recipe, change only the first phase: the first 15% of steps run at 20 px, followed by 24 px for 25%, 28 px for 30% and 32 px for 30%. The 32 px tail keeps its exact step count and position, and the LR and EMA schedules are unchanged. Warm up and capture the 20 px graph in build with channels_last tensors from the training code path, with error_on_recompile on.
